name: Hubbl
description: Hubbl scans your Salesforce orgs and turns the results into context Claude can use. Get read-only access across configuration and code (objects, fields, flows, triggers, workflows, Apex, and code-quality findings), access and licensing (profiles, permission sets, license usage, connected apps, installed packages), and adoption (login activity, object usage, cloud usage, package usage, org limits, field utilization), alongside Hubbl's prioritized issues and recommendations for keeping orgs secure, well-architected, and clean. Ask what to fix first, compare one org or many, and pull step-by-step remediation guidance for any finding. The server performs no writes, so nothing in Salesforce or Hubbl changes.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Hubbl to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Hubbl to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.hubbl.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Hubbl MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hubbl lists 43 MCP tools, including get_org_cloud_usage, get_org_code_count, get_org_connected_app, get_org_es_lint, get_org_field, get_org_flow, get_org_info, get_org_installed_package, get_org_item, get_org_license_usage, get_org_limit, and get_org_login_activity_overview.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Hubbl?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Hubbl in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Hubbl requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Hubbl is developed by Hubbl Technologies, Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
